parent.intent: Phase-blended heuristic that lets greedy distance dominate early tour construction while progressively shifting weight to return_distance and regret as the tour fills. Cluster_density modulates the regret multiplier so dense local regions amplify regret (where positional decisions matter most for tour locality) while sparse uniform regions keep regret moderate (preserving distance ranking). This contrasts the parent's spread-reliability gate: instead of trusting regret more when distances vary widely, we trust regret more when the local region is dense with remaining cities. Targets the uniform gap by reducing regret amplification there (parent's gate runs hot on wide spreads), while picking up regret signal in clustered instances where it was previously suppressed. All weights stay bounde
parent.code:
def priority(f):
    p = f['progress']
    cd = f['cluster_density']
    dw = 1.0 - 0.4*p
    rgw = (0.1 + 0.4*p*p) * (0.6 + 0.4*cd)
    rw = 0.1 + 0.5*p*p
    return -dw*f['distance'] + rw*f['return_distance'] + rgw*f['regret']
